question_text: What was the net person flow (person_entry events minus person_exit events) at Gate_MainEntrance on 2025-12-08 (UTC)?
answer_text: The net person flow at Gate_MainEntrance on 2025-12-08 (UTC) was 179.

citations.sql:
SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'person_entry' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) -
     SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'person_exit' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS net_person_flow
FROM 
    events
WHERE 
    camera_location = 'Gate_MainEntrance' 
    AND timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' 
    AND timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
    AND event_type IN ('person_entry', 'person_exit')
